name: Warranty claims from installers
description: A manufacturer of zoned HVAC controls sells through distributors and installers. Installers send warranty claims for faulty thermostats, dampers and control boards; aftersales checks eligibility, diagnoses the fault remotely and issues a return or a replacement.

steps.name: Register the claim from the installer
steps.description: Read the installer's email or web form with the serial number, purchase invoice, fault description and photos, and open a case in the CRM
problems: the end customer's address and phone travel in free text

steps.name: Check warranty eligibility
steps.description: Look up the serial number in the ERP and compare the date on the purchase invoice with the warranty period
problems: the warranty period changed for invoices after a cut-off date

steps.name: Ask the installer for missing documents
steps.description: Request the purchase invoice, a readable serial number or photos of the installed unit when they are missing
problems: cases wait days for a reply

steps.name: Diagnose the fault remotely with the installer
steps.description: Video call with the installer on site to rule out wiring, configuration or communication errors before accepting a return
steps.output_description: Confirmed fault or fixed on site
problems: many returns turn out to be configuration errors

steps.name: Issue the RMA number and replacement order
steps.description: Create the return authorisation, the shipping label and the replacement order for the distributor

steps.name: Inspect the returned unit in the lab
steps.description: Test the returned board or thermostat and record the root cause for quality
problems: root causes are not linked back to the case

steps.name: Approve the credit note or free replacement
steps.description: The aftersales manager approves the cost of the replacement or the credit note to the distributor
